title: verbascum brachysepalum
intro: Verbascum brachysepalum, commonly known as short-leaved mullein, is a flowering plant species in the mullein genus. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as soothing inflammation and reducing respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Verbascum brachysepalum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which can aid in relieving coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and mucilages, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
